newsitem.title: USA: Genesis to sell unit to investment group.
newsitem.headline: Genesis to sell unit to investment group.

text.p: Genesis International Financial Services Inc. said Friday it has agreed in principle to sell its major operating unit, CRIC, for $117 million to an international investment group.
The group is led by Suisse Private Banking Ltd. and InterFinance Banking Group, which represent a group of European and Arabic investors

Genesis, a diversified holding company, will retain the Miller Mountain Gold Mining operation, Guarantee Settlement Corp. Inc. and Longhorn Energy Corp Inc., which are presently held by CRIC, Genesis said.

The deal will be structured around a fully collateralized international promissory note, a long-term consulting contract and an international security agreement bonded by a major European carrier, Genesis said.
The parties have agreed to close the deal within 45 days, after which it will begin generating income for Genesis in the second quarter, the company said.
Genesis has investments in the financial services, medical products, agricultural, real estate and gold mining industries.
Genesis' stock rose 59.4 cents to $2.56 on the Nasdaq bulletin board.
